_comment: The short 'Why this matters' section on the results screen. At most 4 lines, each with a checked source.

lines.text: Almost all of our land birds (96%) depend on insects that native plants support.
Native plants need less watering and fertilizer, so less fertilizer washes into our water, where too much of it can cause algae blooms.
Invasive plants clog South Florida's waterways, which makes flood control harder for the 8.1 million people who live here.
A study near Washington, D.C., found chickadees only raised enough young to keep their numbers up in yards where at least 70% of the plants, by size, were native.
